title: Microsoft Dataverse: Python SDK for scripting and agent workflows
summary: Hold: enabling environment auditing alone does not ensure scripted changes are recorded; table and column auditing must also be enabled. The briefing also overstates gaps in documentation for application identity and app-access automation, and makes unsupported assumptions about credential storage and rollout.
